1339-1832-5231-7492.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-7492.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1168-1479-2841-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1168-1479-2841-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

553-4586-5858.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Gandalf.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

427-4644-7791.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
427-4644-7791.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Kydele.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Kydele.
Repeat.

933-2104-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Conjurer's Closet.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-618-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Birgi and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

862-2438-4053-6989.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

789-2399-5231--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-5231--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Thermopod by sacrificing that creature, adding {R}.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {R}.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
789-2399-5231--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

222-527-3480-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3480-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1350-1563-4010-4231.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {3}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens, three Food tokens, three Clue tokens and three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Foods and three Clues by tapping them, adding six {G}.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-3742-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

224-2366-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dryad Arbor that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-1430--39.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-1430--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Mirror Image trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

141-1223-2438.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-2438.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.

3366-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wall of Deceit, adding {U}.
When Wall of Deceit dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Wall of Deceit from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Wall of Deceit's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-5313.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 24 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 3.
4567-5313.description:
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2438-4294-5220.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.

2020-2430-5195.notablePrerequisites: Vadrik has a power of four or greater.
2020-2430-5195.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

722-1430-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Mirror Image each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

842-4569.description:
Whenever a nontoken creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, Eye of Singularity and Faerie Artisans triggers.
Resolve the Eye of Singularity trigger, destroying nothing.
Resolve the Faerie Artisans trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that entered the battlefield and exiling all other tokens created by Faerie Artisans.
When the token enters the battlefield, Eye of Singularity triggers, destroying all creatures that share a name with that token.

2605-4222-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
2605-4222-4348.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
